name: Inquisitor Redeemer
body:
While many inquisitors are quick to find, exploit and punish faults, there are also those that believe that even those most entrenched in their faults can be set unto the path of light.

Redemption Inquisition

At 1st level, a redeemer must choose the redemption inquisition as his domain/inquisition.

This ability alters domain.

Rhetorician (Ex)

At 2nd level, a redeemer receives a bonus on all Diplomacy checks equal to 1/2 his inquisitor level. Furthermore, he can use Diplomacy to influence a creature’s attitude in combat, provided the creature can understand him. This takes a full-round action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity, and the check is made with a -10 penalty.

This ability replaces track.

Blade of Mercy (Ex)

At 5th level, when the redeemer wields a weapon with the merciful magic weapon special ability (including the weapons that gain this ability via the Redeemer’s Mercy inquisition power of the redemption inquisition), the extra damage gained from the merciful magic weapon special ability increases to 2d6. At 12th level, that extra damage increases to 4d6.

This ability replaces bane and greater bane.
